activities.title: Listen. What might they be? Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Maya y Oliver (dudando sobre el futuro).
data.script: Oliver: Maya, what might you be in the future? … Maya: Hmm. I might be a vet, because I love animals. … Maya: Or an inventor — I already have eleven ideas in my notebook. … Oliver: Eleven! I might be a music teacher. Or a farmer with singing cows! … Maya: Singing cows?! … Oliver: Why not? Happy cows, better milk. It's science! … Maya: And Diego says he might write books one day. Adventure books. … Oliver: One thing is sure: whatever we are, we'll still be a team. … Maya: That's the only thing I don't say might about!

homework.prompt: Write 5 sentences about your future: 3 with might, 1 with will (something sure) and 1 with won't.
